wallpapers.name: Porcelain Dunes
wallpapers.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original premium television launcher wallpaper, intended for commercial distribution in Bloom. Create ONE full bleed landscape 16:9 image, ideally 3840x2160. No text, letters, logos, watermark, UI, borders, collage or panels. Sophisticated restrained editorial art direction, smooth natural tonal transitions, exceptional material and light quality. This is a backdrop behind clear and frosted glass app tiles and colorful Continue Watching posters. Keep top-left 30% very calm for clock. App tiles can sit either around 45-60% height with shows below or at 75-90% height without shows. Therefore keep entire lower half low contrast, broad color fields without small objects. Main sculptural interest in upper-middle/right third. Distinct dimensional forms visible through clear glass and softly tinted through frost. Not a generic gradient, no small repeated texture. Photoreal fine-art pale ivory gypsum dunes, one elegant wind-sculpted crest sweeping diagonally from middle-left toward upper-right, champagne and muted blush shadow, luminous pearl empty sky, soft dawn side lighting. Vast calm foreground. Light mode, predominantly light warm ivory with just enough beige tonal depth to reveal glass edges. No sun disk, footprints, vegetation.
